international.title: Grieving families getting into debt and doing without memorials due to benefit freezes
international.summary: MPs to discuss bereavement support as financial help for funeral expenses and bereaved families fails to keep pace with costs Bereaved families are borrowing money or forgoing a service with mourners because financial help available from the state no longer covers even half a typical funeral director’s fee. “The funeral expenses payment (FSP) was originally meant to cover the cost of a simple funeral. Today, that is a pipe dream,” said Lindesay Mace, a co-manager of Down to Earth, a funeral costs support service run by the charity Quaker Social Action. Continue reading...
